title: Hold a licence to operate a launch facility
what: Operating a launch facility in Australia needs a launch facility licence (or another authorisation the Act allows).

sources.title: Space (Launches and Returns) Act 2018
sources.locator: launch facility licence requirement (compilation C2024C00604 from 2024-10-14)
sources.quote: A person must not operate a launch facility in Australia, or do anything directly connected with operating a launch facility in Australia, unless: (a) the person holds a launch facility licence for the launch facility;

reach.condition: if it operates a launch facility
